customPresets: Replace the compaction-basic provider with @missher/dsh-context-manager/engine explicitly. Saved preset overrides take precedence.

runtimeCapabilities.idleMaintenanceSelection: BasicCompactionEngine.selectMaintenanceRange; missing capability skips idle compaction before billing
runtimeCapabilities.protectedToolPruning: toolResultPruner.supportsProtectedSeqs === true; missing capability skips pruning
runtimeCapabilities.durableMetadata: storageDomain for idle eligibility and summary usage
runtimeCapabilities.summaryAbortCommit: BasicCompactionEngine.supportsSummaryAbortCommit === true; otherwise compaction is blocked before a billable call
runtimeCapabilities.storageShutdownDrain: storageDomain.registerDrain for both context_manager_idle and context_manager_summaries, backed by each actual backend; otherwise compaction is blocked

verification.distribution: Context 0.8.0-local.7 was accepted with custom rc.2 plus summary commit cancellation and JSON storage drain fixes. See PUBLICATION.md for exact source and validation evidence.
verification.officialHarnessOnly: Full plugin acceptance on unmodified official rc.2 was not performed. Missing optional capabilities follow runtimeCapabilities.
verification.presetSourceShaMeaning: sourceSha identifies the preset-source baseline, not an assertion of full compatibility with that commit.
